chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Isma'il ibn Abd al-Khaliq said:

I heard Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) while he was saying: 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar divorced his wife three times, so the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) counted it as one, and returned her to the Book and the Sunnah.'
ai.seo_question: How did the Prophet Muhammad treat a triple divorce pronounced in a single sitting according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Imam al-Sadiq’s (peace be upon him) legal reasoning that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) corrected the practice of 'Umar ibn al-Khattab by treating a triple divorce pronounced in a single sitting as a single revocable divorce. By returning the matter to 'the Book and the Sunnah,' the Imam emphasizes the Quranic standard of three distinct divorces over the course of time, rather than three simultaneous pronouncements, a view central to Shia jurisprudence on *Talaq al-Sunah*.
